# QuotaPin 1.0.2

One download, two ways in.

- Double-click `QuotaPin-1.0.2.exe` for guided Windows setup, the tray companion, startup, and an Apps uninstall entry.
- The PowerShell Quick Start downloads the same executable and installs quiet watcher mode without starting the tray.
- Slow downloads show progress and retry from the partial file after an interruption.
- Install, update, and uninstall leave Codex open. If the current window is not attachable, QuotaPin waits for the next normal Codex launch.
- Windows package identity checks accept the harmless padding used by version resources while still requiring the exact version, filename, repository, digest, and immutable GitHub release.

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WSL043/QuotaPin-for-Codex/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

Windows 10 version 2004 or newer, x64, with the current Codex desktop app.
